title: Updates the elements.update() method to return a Promise
summary: Adds support for async and await patterns when updating an Elements object by changing the elements.update() method to return a Promise<void>. The return type of elements.update() has changed from void to Promise<void>. TypeScript integrations that explicitly type the return value need to update their types. If your integration otherwise expects elements.update() to return void, you might also need to update your code.

The return type of `elements.update()` has changed from `void` to `Promise<void>`. TypeScript integrations that explicitly type the return value need to update their types. If your integration otherwise expects `elements.update()` to return `void`, you might also need to update your code.
